karina-macias.text: Part of the 4-0 council vote (Flores absent, June 2026) extending HP Contigo, created during the 2025 immigration raids, which offers legal help to residents detained by ICE, rapid response and Know Your Rights outreach.

source.title: The SELA Sun: Huntington Park extends HP With You program through 2027 (Jun 27, 2026)

nancy-cindy-martiz.text: As a sitting councilmember, part of the 4-0 vote (Flores absent, June 2026) extending HP Contigo, created during the 2025 immigration raids, which offers legal help to residents detained by ICE, rapid response and Know Your Rights outreach.

source.title: The SELA Sun: Huntington Park extends HP With You program through 2027 (Jun 27, 2026)

notes: Macias and Martiz are both listed as sitting councilmembers on hpca.gov, so both were among the four ayes. Huntington Park posts no candidate statements. No public positions found for karina-miketta. Searches used: 10
